title: Impact framing consult
summary: Clarify the change you want to influence and who benefits.
detailsWho: Researchers shaping a new project or early concept.
detailsWhat: Work with a facilitator to define the public need, intended outcomes, and early partners.
detailsOutcomes: A concise impact statement and a first-pass pathway map.

title: Partner readiness check
summary: Assess roles, expectations, and collaboration readiness.
detailsWhat: Review partner roles, decision-making, and communication plans.
detailsOutcomes: A short readiness checklist and recommended adjustments.

title: Grant impact narrative workshop
summary: Translate impact goals into funder-ready language.
detailsWho: Applicants preparing impact sections for grants.
detailsWhat: Draft and refine impact narratives with peer feedback.
detailsOutcomes: A stronger narrative aligned to funder criteria.

title: Engagement plan clinic
summary: Design engagement activities that fit your timeline.
detailsWho: Projects with active partners or public-facing goals.
detailsWhat: Build a schedule of touchpoints, events, and feedback loops.
detailsOutcomes: An engagement plan you can implement immediately.

title: Outcome tracking consult
summary: Choose practical indicators to document change.
detailsWho: Teams who need light-weight evaluation support.
detailsWhat: Select indicators and tools that align with your goals.
detailsOutcomes: A simple outcome tracking plan and evidence checklist.

title: Impact documentation
summary: Collect evidence and short narratives of change.
detailsWho: Projects preparing reports or final outputs.
detailsWhat: Gather outputs, testimonials, and outcome evidence.
detailsOutcomes: A concise impact brief ready for reporting.

title: Knowledge sharing strategy
summary: Select formats that reach the right audiences.
detailsWhat: Choose formats, channels, and timing for outreach.
detailsOutcomes: A tailored dissemination plan with priorities.

title: Impact pathway mapping session
summary: Visualize how outputs connect to outcomes over time.
detailsWho: Researchers who want a clear, shared impact model.
detailsWhat: Map outputs, short-term outcomes, and long-term goals.
detailsOutcomes: A pathway map that supports planning and communication.
